hints.title: Almost Equal Characters
hints.text: Two characters are almost equal if their character code difference is at most 1.

hints.title: Greedy Modification
hints.text: When word[i] and word[i - 1] are almost equal, changing word[i] can fix both (word[i-1], word[i]) and potential conflict with word[i+1].

hints.title: Skip Next Position
hints.text: After modifying word[i], advance by 2 positions to i + 2 to avoid double counting.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass greedy conflict resolution advancing by 2.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all possible replaced characters is unnecessary.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that greedy change of the right character of an invalid pair resolves future conflicts.
